title: On the solution of functional equations by the method of regularization
relevant_theorem_equation: ||A x_alpha - y^delta|| = tau * delta, tau in [1.0, 1.2]
exact_relevance: Establishes the fundamental discrepancy principle for ill-posed operator equations
claim_supported: Residual should match measurement noise level delta; driving residual to zero amplifies noise

title: Stable signal recovery from noisy measurements
authors: Candes, E. J.; Romberg, J. K.; Tao, T.
publication: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics
relevant_theorem_equation: Theorem 1.1: min ||x||_1 s.t. ||Ax - y||_2 <= epsilon, epsilon^2 = sigma^2(M + 2*sqrt(2M))
exact_relevance: Defines the exact statistical noise ball radius epsilon in noisy compressed sensing (BPDN)
claim_supported: Optimal sparse recovery solution lies on the noise boundary epsilon ~ sigma * sqrt(M), not 0

title: Atomic decomposition by basis pursuit
authors: Chen, S. S.; Donoho, D. L.; Saunders, M. A.
relevant_theorem_equation: Optimality: A_S^T (y - A_S x) = lambda * sign(x_S)
exact_relevance: Demonstrates that BPDN residual norm is dominated by shrinkage bias proportional to lambda
claim_supported: Non-zero residual is the natural mathematical consequence of sparsity regularization

title: Compressed sensing
relevant_theorem_equation: Oracle noise bound: ||(I - P_S) e||_2 ~ sigma * sqrt(M - k)
exact_relevance: Geometric decomposition of noise into support subspace and orthogonal complement
claim_supported: Even an ideal oracle estimator with exact support cannot achieve residual below sigma*sqrt(M-k)

title: Regularization of Inverse Problems
authors: Engl, H. W.; Hanke, M.; Neubauer, A.
relevant_theorem_equation: Rule 6.2 & Theorem 6.4: stop at first k* where ||A x_k - y|| <= tau * delta
exact_relevance: Proves semi-convergence in iterative solvers: iterating beyond discrepancy threshold diverges
claim_supported: Iterative solvers must stop when residual hits discrepancy threshold to prevent noise fitting

title: A fast approach for addressing L0 minimization problems and its applications
authors: Mohimani, H.; Babaie-Zadeh, M.; Jutten, C.
relevant_theorem_equation: Section IV.B: stop continuation when ||A s - y||_2 <= sqrt(M) * sigma_noise
exact_relevance: Foundational paper for Smoothed L0 continuation; explicitly addresses noisy measurements
claim_supported: Creators of SL0 explicitly warn against projecting onto As=y under noise, advising discrepancy stopping

title: Image denoising via sparse and redundant representations over learned dictionaries
relevant_theorem_equation: Section III: stop pursuit when ||r||_2 <= C * sigma * sqrt(M), C = 1.15
exact_relevance: Standardized stopping criterion for patch-based sparse image restoration (K-SVD, OMP)
claim_supported: Peak image quality coincides exactly with residual C*sigma*sqrt(M); lower residual causes severe PSNR drops

title: Confidence intervals and hypothesis testing for high-dimensional regression
exact_relevance: Analyzes variance inflation in two-stage refitting and debiased LASSO
claim_supported: Unconstrained debiasing causes catastrophic variance collapse when active support approaches M
